task_description: , 'description': 'This container provides a unified, stateless mock API service for ecommerce scenarios, supporting product listing, product details, cart management, order simulation, and mocked authentication. It is designed for rapid development, testing, and demonstration, enabling frontend and integration teams to work independently of a real backend. All data is dummy and managed in-memory or via static files, ensuring predictable and isolated test environments. The container exposes RESTful APIs, fully documented with OpenAPI/Swagger, and is packaged as a single Docker image for easy deployment. Automated test execution is integrated via Postman, supporting CI/CD workflows and quality assurance.
